title: SKE Crystal Plus Sakura Grape Prefilled Pods 20mg
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Riberry Lemonade flavour SKE Crystal Plus prefilled pods offer a vibrant blend of rich, tangy blackcurrant cordial and zesty, sparkling lemonade for a uniquely refreshing and fruity beverage-inspired vape. The combination of bold, dark berry notes and bright, fizzy citrus undertones creates a perfectly balanced flavour with a bright, uplifting finish that’s perfect for any time of day. Compatible with the SKE Crystal Plus Pod Kit, these prefilled pods are a convenient and mess-free solution for on-the-go vaping. Each pod is preloaded with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, delivering a smooth throat hit and fast-acting nicotine satisfaction for a more enjoyable mouth-to-lung (MTL) experience. The integrated 1.1ohm mesh coil ensures consistently rich flavour and vapour production, while the user-friendly pod design eliminates the need for refilling or coil changes. When the pod runs out, simply replace it with a fresh one to continue enjoying the satisfying Riberry Lemonade flavour. Please Note: SKE Crystal Plus pods include a protective seal that must be removed before use. Detach the bung from the top of the mouthpiece and allow the pod to sit for 5-10 minutes to ensure the coil is fully saturated with e-liquid, preventing dry hits or burnt coils
